title: A wear-and-tear repair question retrieves the clause that assigns it

input.message: מי מתקן דוד מים שהתקלקל מבלאי?

retrieval.note: PROVISIONAL — replaced by the rank `npm run measure` reports on the first CI run, which is the only place a real embedder exists. The corpus holds three other passages about who fixes what (§7.5 tenant damage, §7.9 common parts, §11.3 utilities), so this rank has something to lose to.
